class.name: PlayerControl
class.brief_description: Local steering and look for one scene body.
class.description: Returned by [method PlayerControlProfile.boot]. The scene owns the controller. Keep its [Controls] handle on a persistent local owner if settings and bindings should survive body replacement.

method.name: clear_lock_on
method.description: Clears the selected target. Lock-On steering follows the view again. Safe to call after the controller is detached.

method.name: controls
method.description: Returns the exact local input handle used by the controller, or null if boot failed.

method.name: get_message
method.description: Returns the initial attachment failure text, or an empty string after success.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns true while the attached controller and its input owner are live.

method.name: lock_on
method.description: Uses the bearing to [param target] for the body's facing and movement axes. The view keeps its own aim. The game chooses the target and handles any camera tracking. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if the controller is inactive, [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] for other styles, or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for a null, unmounted, queued-for-deletion, same-character, or different-viewport target. Falls back to view heading if the target leaves the viewport or has no horizontal separation. Network owners send steering heading only.

method.name: mover
method.description: Returns the body's movement handle on standalone or authority-side actors. Returns null on a network guest, which sends input intent to the authority, or if boot failed.
